dct_description_sm: This project is intended to record traditional knowledge and archaeology at Huluraq, located northeast of Cambridge Bay.  Huluraq was identified by Cambridge Bay elders as a particularly important place in regional history, due to its location at the east end of Ferguson Lake and at the mouth of the Ekalluk River.  The archaeology of this site was previously unknown.
